paper.title: Do DESI-DR2 BAO data imply a coupling of dark matter and dark energy?

verdict.summary: The exact arXiv v1 PDF is public, but the modified CAMB source and base commit, complete paper-run Cobaya configuration, and explicit scalar perturbation initial conditions were not found in the checked primary sources. APS version-of-record PDF/supplement was not verifiable. A faithful source-paper replication remains blocked; an independent implementation can be clearly labeled as such.

arxiv_source_bundle.hash_method: streamed source archive through sha256sum; archive was not saved

modified_camb_source_and_base_commit.article_claim: The article says it used a modified version of CAMB.
modified_camb_source_and_base_commit.evidence: No repository, patch/diff, release, or commit is given in the article/source bundle. The only explicit software repository link is cited for the evidence-calculation interface, not the CAMB modification.

full_cobaya_configuration.evidence: No run config is in the arXiv source bundle. The paper-cited wgcosmo main tree has generic likelihood/model examples, but no IVS/interacting-DM-DE config matching the paper.

explicit_perturbation_initial_conditions.evidence: The paper specifies synchronous gauge and a dark-sector perturbation closure but not the scalar IC mode or initialization. Literal searches of clean.tex for initial condition(s), adiabatic, isocurvature, and primordial returned no matches. Without the run config, the actual CAMB IC setting cannot be inferred.

aps_version_of_record_and_supplement.issue_result: The partial Volume 114, Issue 6 listing, current to 2026-09-24, did not list the title or DOI.
aps_version_of_record_and_supplement.supplement_result: Accepted-paper page says author supplements, if provided, become available upon version-of-record publication.

linked_repository_snapshot.why_paper_links_it: The article cites its Cobaya interface for the MCEvidence calculation.
linked_repository_snapshot.tree_finding: Generic Planck/CMB, BAO/DESI DR2, and standard model YAML examples are present. No IVS/interacting configuration or modified-CAMB repository/patch appears in the current main tree; an introductory CAMB notebook is unrelated to source-paper provenance.
linked_repository_snapshot.inspection_limit: Repository metadata and tree paths only; no repository code was downloaded or run. This does not exclude private, unlinked, or later-published artifacts.
